\[
\frac{\text{FY2023 revenue} - \text{FY2022 revenue}}{\text{FY2022 revenue}}
= \frac{574.785 - 513.983}{513.983}
= 0.1183
\]

So revenue grew by approximately **11.83% year over year**.

Evidence: FY2023 revenue of **$574.785B** (accession `0001018724-24-000008`, filed 2024-02-02) and FY2022 revenue of **$513.983B** (accession `0001018724-23-000004`, filed 2023-02-03), both under the XBRL concept `RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax`.

ANSWER: 11.83%
